newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sunway in Cambodian development venture.
newsitem.headline: Sunway in Cambodian development venture.

text.p: Malaysia's property developer Sunway City Bhd said its 76 percent-owned subsidiary, Sunway City (Cambodia) Sdn Bhd has entered into a joint venture agreement with the Cambodian government to develop 400 hectares of land in Phnom Penh.
Sunway said in a statement a joint venture company will be set up to undertake the integrated township project.
Sunway City Cambodia will hold an 80 percent stake in the company which will have a share capital of $10 million. The Cambodian government take up the rest.
The period of lease for the land is 70 years with an option for another 70 years, the statement said.
